question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Acquisitive
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Eager'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is: **'****Acquisitive'.(अर्जनशील)**
 
• The word **'Acquisitive'** means excessively interested in acquiring money or material things.
 
 
• **Example:** *We live in a competitive and **acquisitive** society.*
 
 
 
• The word **'Eager'(इच्छुक****)** means strongly wanting to do or have something.
 
 
• **Example:** *The man was **eager** to please.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Critical'** means adverse or disapproving comments or judgements.(संकटपूर्ण)
 
• **'Apathetic'** means showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.(उदासीन)
 
• **'Aspiring'** means directing one's hopes or ambitions towards becoming a specified type of person.(आकांक्षी)
